about: Move ♥ Me · Monie knowledge feed. Static facts come from the Move Me research Sheet (Monie tabs); 'live' blocks are refreshed by scripts/refresh_feed.py. Horoscopes are entertainment, not data.

dates.question: Which cities are best for dates?
dates.says: San Francisco tops the 2026 date-night ranking: lots of affordable restaurants, florists and things to do, and it's the most walkable big city. Top 5: San Francisco, San Diego, Las Vegas, Atlanta, Seattle.
facts: OpenTable's Top 100 Romantic Restaurants 2026 has winners in 38 states, ranked from 9M+ verified diner reviews.
52% of Americans planned to dine out on Valentine's Day 2026 (OpenTable).
Rochester, NY is #1 on ConsumerAffairs' 2026 best cities for dating.
sources: WalletHub: Best Places for Valentine's Day 2026
dates.refresh: Yearly: WalletHub (early Feb), OpenTable Top 100 (late Jan)

singles.question: Which cities have the most singles?
singles.says: These cities have the biggest share of adults who've never married: Detroit (57.4%), Boston (56.6%), Rochester (56.4%), Washington DC (55.1%), Milwaukee (55.1%). For the best odds overall, WalletHub ranks Atlanta #1 for singles and Las Vegas #2.
facts: 76% of U.S. singles believe romantic love can last forever, up from 73% (Singles in America 2026).
72% of Gen Z singles want to marry, the most of any generation.
Washington DC has 84.5 single men per 100 single women; Fremont, CA has 136.7.
sources: SmartAsset: Where Most People Are Single or Married, 2026
singles.refresh: Yearly: Census ACS (Sept), Singles in America (Sept), WalletHub singles (Dec)

family.question: Which cities are best for starting a family?
family.says: For raising a family, these cities score highest on schools, safety, affordability and family fun: Fremont, Overland Park, Plano, Irvine, South Burlington. Fremont has been #1 four years running.
facts: Lowest 2024 divorce rates per 1,000 residents: Louisiana 0.8, Illinois 1.3, Massachusetts 1.5, Kansas 1.7, Iowa 1.8 (CDC/NCHS).
sources: WalletHub: Best Places to Raise a Family 2025

married.question: Best cities to get married in?
married.says: The best-value cities to say "I do": Las Vegas, Orlando, Miami, Atlanta, Tampa (then Austin and Houston). The average U.S. wedding cost $34,200 in 2025; New Jersey is priciest (about $57k), Wyoming cheapest (about $17k).
facts: Highest 2024 marriage rates per 1,000 residents: Nevada 24.8, Utah 13.4, Hawaii 12.4, DC 10.1, Montana 9.2 (CDC/NCHS, counted where the wedding happens).
sources: WalletHub: Best Places to Get Married 2026

pay.question: Which cities pay the highest in my industry?
pay.says: Match the person's industry to the closest common job and list the five states with the highest median pay for it (BLS OEWS, May 2025). Unmatched industries get the highest-paying metros: Bremerton, San Francisco, Seattle, San Jose, Boulder.
sources: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025

hiring.question: Which regions are hiring the most right now?
hiring.says: The South is hiring hardest. In 2025 the job openings rate was highest in Georgia (5.5%), Alaska (5.4%), West Virginia (5.3%), Oklahoma (5.2%) and Mississippi (5.0%); the U.S. average was 4.3%.
facts: WalletHub's best cities to find a job (2026): Scottsdale, Columbia MD, Portland ME, South Burlington, Pittsburgh.
sources: BLS: job openings rates by state, 2025
Indeed Hiring Lab: Job Postings Index by state (weekly, CC BY 4.0)
hiring.refresh: Weekly (automatic): Indeed postings by state. Yearly: BLS JOLTS state annual (spring)

fortune500.question: Which cities have the most Fortune 500 companies?
fortune500.says: These metros are home to the most Fortune 500 headquarters: New York (49), Chicago (30), Houston (26), San Jose (21), Washington DC (20). By state, Texas leads with 57, just ahead of California (56) and New York (53).
sources: RealPage: Markets with the most Fortune 500 HQs, 2026

business.question: Which cities are best for starting a business?
business.says: Florida sweeps the top 5 for starting a business (Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville, Hialeah, St. Petersburg). Americans filed a record 5.7 million business applications in 2025, and Wyoming files the most per person.
facts: U.S. business applications, Oct 2026: 501,609 (seasonally adjusted), down 6.0% from Sept (Census BFS, released Nov 12, 2026).
sources: WalletHub: Best Large Cities to Start a Business 2026 (KTVU)

horoscope.says: Monie pairs the person's sun sign with their top cities for fun. Horoscopes are entertainment, not data. Location astrology (astrocartography) needs birth date, time and place.
